اعتدوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَوْا (iʕtadaw) /iʕ.ta.daw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اُعْتُدُوا (uʕtudū) /uʕ.tu.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اِعْتَدُوا (iʕtadū) /iʕ.ta.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
